mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which drives corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate rises above 5% but the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment (UNRATE) increase simultaneously, it indicates labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both employment and unemployment increase but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates tight monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate is above 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) leads to higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 50-period moving average signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production falls below 100 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong but inflation (CPIAUCSL) is also high, the combination may lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both GDP growth and CPIAUCSL are high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 units signals a slowdown in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If housing starts fall below 1000 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
